text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CHINA, Sept 26 - Keelung - three vessels anchored, berthing delays coal 6 days, steel 2 days, iron ore 3 days. No delays for grain. Kaohsiung - three vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 1 day, iron/coal 3 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), steel 1 day. Taichung - five vessels anchored. Berthing delays iron ore, coal, others 1-2 days, no delays for grain, scrap. Sept 30, Keelung - vessels in port 11 containers, 1 tanker, 2 general, 9 containers waiting at outer anchorage with 1 days delay. Kaohsiung - vessels in port 10 containers, 7 tankers, 2 grain, 3 other bulkers, 41 generals. No delays.

INDIA, Oct 1- Bombay - delays container vessels 1-2 days, bulk 7-8 days, general cargo 9-10. 4 vessels loading at berth, 26 discharging, 7 discharging at anchorage, 6 waiting to load, 15 to discharge, 6 under repairs, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 17 due of which 1 coal, 12 products, 4 containers. 6 loading at berth, 11 discharging, 1 bunkering. Cochin - vessels due 2 liners, 1 mop/dap/urea, 1 steel/grain/coal/sugar. Up to 1 days delay, 1 rock phosphate/sulphur, 10-12 days delay, 1 crude tanker, 2-3 days delay, 2 petroleum products, 2 days. Waiting at anchorage 3 tankers, 1 for loading, 2 for discharging. 2 in drydock. Mormugao - delays to 1 day for containers, petroleum, phosphoric acid, 3-4 days for ores. 2 vessels loading at berth, 3 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge, 5 under repairs/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - delays rice 11-12 days, rock phosphate 13-17 days, steel coils 11-12 days, granite blocks 7-8 days, coils 4-5 days, timber 7-8 days, scrap 6-7 days. 3 loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 5 discharging at berth, 7 waiting to load, 1 to discharge. 3 tankers. 15 tankers waiting. Mangalore delays granite blocks to 1 day. 3 loading at berth, 1 discharging, 2 awaiting berth, 1 other. Madras - 35 due of which 7 coal/coke, 1 edible oil, 12 containers, 10 general, 1 fertiliser, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 sugar, 1 steel, 1 other. Delays coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-4, scrap 4-5, others 2-3. 15 loading at berth, 13 discharging, 7 waiting, 1 under repairs/drydock. Jawaharlal Nehru - three due (fertiliser, raw materials), 15-20 days delay. 2 others (tanker, iron ore) due, 2-3 days delay. 4 discharging at berth, 4 at anchorage to discharge. Paradip - vessels due 4 coal, 2 days delay, 1 iron ore, 2 days delay, 1 food, no delay. Other delays chrome 4 days, fertiliser 10 days. 2 loading at berth, 3 discharging, 1 waiting to load, 2 to discharge. Tuticorin - eight due, 1-2 days delay, 2 loading at berth, 3 discharging, 1 waiting to load, 1 to discharge. Visakhapatnam - 15 due, 1-2 days delay (thermal coal, pig iron, ilmenite, granite blocks, coking coal, containers, phosphoric acid, palmoil, containers, sulphur, coke, general cargo, limestone, logs, coal/coke, 6 loading, 6 discharging, 2 waiting to load at inner harbour berth, 3 to discharge.

S.KOREA, Oct 1 - Inchon - 94 vessels in port (51 berthed, 43 anchored) of which 10 logs, 7 general cargo, 5 steel, 4 container vessels, 3 plywood, 2 each h-beam, rapemeal, pulp, cars, corn, scrap, 1 each ingots, alfalfa, wheat pellets, coil, pig iron, maize, rye, raw sugar. Anchored 6 general cargo, 6 cars, 6 container, 4 logs, 3 each pig iron, steel, 2 each wheat, copra, rapemeal, soymeal, 1 each cement, tapioca, cottonseed meal, coils, ingots, plywood, pulp. 3 days delay expected.

Busan - 169 in port (49 berthed, 120 anchored including 60 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal, 60 awaiting berth. 2 Days delay. Pohang - 12 berthed of which discharging 1 each iron ore, coal, scrap, perlite, hot briquette iron, coils. 6 loading steel, no delays expected. Ulsan - 25 vessels in port (20 berthed, 5 anchored) of which discharging 5 chemicals, 2 woodchips, 1 each logs, feedmeal, oil, zinc concentrate, lead concentrate, other. Loading 1 each steel pipes, resin, paraffin, naphtha, chemicals, kerosene, styrene monomer. 5 feed vessels awaiting berth, over 15 days delay expected. Masan - six berthed, discharging 3 steel scrap, 1 each cement, bananas, steel, no delays expected.

MALAYSIA, Oct 2 - Port Klang container berths 1 vessel alongside 1 berthing 2/10. Deep draft conventional wharf 4 vessels alongside, 2 berthing 2/10, 1 waiting, 3 due 3/10. Waiting time 3 days. Dry bulk terminal 2 vessels alongside, 2 waiting. Waiting time 4 days. West port 4 conventional vessels alongside, 2 cement carrier vessels alongside discharging.

SRI LANKA, Oct 1 - Colombo - 12 vessels due. 1 Days delay expected. 13 vessels loading at berth (5 general cargo, 8 container vessels. 14 vessels discharging at berth (1 flour, 1 lentils, 1 bagged cement, 2 general cargo, 1 bulk cement, 8 container vessels). 3 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 1 container, 1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged soymeal. 1 vessel outside harbour for bunkers. 5 under repairs/drydock. 3 awaiting orders. Galle - two vessels discharging at berth. 1 vessel loading at berth. Trincomalee - two vessels loading at berth.

PAKISTAN, Sept 30 - Karachi - Nine vessels due, 48 hours delay expected. 3 containers loading and discharging at berth. 7 vessels discharging at berth (dap, iron, sugar, mtb/meg) 2 waiting at anchorage to load (general cargo, clinker) 8 waiting to discharge (dap, chemicals, fuel oil, sugar).

PHILIPPINES, Oct 1 - Manila - South harbour no vessels loading at berth or anchorage. 14 discharging at berth, 8 at anchorage, 12 waiting outside anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. 8 other vessels withholding orders. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 metres and LOA less than 130 metres 1-3 days, draft greater than 9 metres/LOA greater than 140 metres 2-3 days.
